write_side_summary.who_writes_the_authority: a human commit editing dev/agent-workflow/graph.yaml; guarded only by the YAML-parse pre-commit hook (MC-09) and the ci-pr-gate legs after the fact
write_side_summary.machine_writers_of_the_authority: NONE found (verified by grepping every fs write in scripts/; no script writes graph.yaml)
write_side_summary.consequence: the single write point is a discipline, not a tool; any claim of a single write point after migration must name the guard that makes it true
